articles.title: Toyota Shifts Leadership As US EV Launch Tests Long Term Priorities
articles.mainIdea: Toyota Shifts Leadership As US EV Launch Tests Long Term Priorities
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Toyota Shifts Leadership As US EV Launch Tests Long Term Priorities. Toyota Motor (TSE:7203) has announced a leadership reshuffle, with Kenta Kon set to become President and CEO and Koji Sato moving to Vice Chairman and Chief Industry Officer. The changes are intended to support faster decision-making as Sato takes on broader responsibilities in key industry bodies.
